messages.content: The current masking pipeline matches the contract except for one requirement: "Every result role is tool and ID matches the positional call." The code only checks `ids.includes(message.tool_call_id)`, not positional matching with the corresponding call at the same index. I'll restore that positional check.

But maybe bug: "ID matches the positional call" — messages.slice(1).entries() index should match calls[index], but code only checks ids.includes. Fix: message.tool_call_id === ids[index]. Also history.length <= 12 ok. Propose fix.
